PLAN "12-Week General Strength Programme for Post-Discal Rehabilitation (No Heavy Spinal Loading or Loaded Flexion)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general strength with spine-friendly, progressive overload while avoiding heavy spinal loading and loaded spinal flexion"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "GPP Foundation A":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell incline press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell goblet squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          treadmill 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Core-Friendly Push-Pull":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Dumbbell bench press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Cable row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Leg extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Cable face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Leg Stability & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          treadmill incline walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Trap bar deadlift (lower loading emphasis) 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian deadlift (DB or barbell, light) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Glute bridge (hip thrust) 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Hamstring curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          supine windshield wipers 2x10
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength Hypertrophy Blend A":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Barbell back squat (controlled depth) 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell bench press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Bent-over barbell row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Vertical Push/Pull Focus":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Overhead press (DB or bar) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Lat pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated dumbbell row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          farmers carry 3x30 seconds each hand
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower Body Strength with Spine Safety":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Leg press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat (bodyweight or light hold) 3x8..10 per leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Hip hinge drill (trap bar or DB) 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip flexor/quad stretch flow 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Block Progression A":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat 4x5..7 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Barbell incline bench press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pull-ups or assisted pull-down 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Dumbbell Romanian deadlift 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Core and Posture Stabilization":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Landmine press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Seated cable row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          Bird-dog progressions 3x10 per side
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 65m "Hip Hinge & Unilateral Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Deadlift (light to moderate) 4x5..7 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Bulgarian split squat 4x6..8 per leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Glute drive 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Ab wheel or DB rollouts 3x8..12
        cooldown:
          glute/hamstring stretch 5 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Maximizing Strength Blocks A":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Back squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Bench press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Bent-over row 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Pallof press 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility flow 5 minutes
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Rotational/Anti-rotational Core & Posture":
        warmup:
          bike 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Cable woodchop 3x12..15 per side
          Suitcase carry 3x40 seconds per side
          Plank variations 3x40 seconds
          Face pull/Scapular retraction 3x12..15
        cooldown:
          thoracic mobility 5 minutes
    WEEK 13:
      DAY Friday training 70m "Integrated Strength Finish":
        warmup:
          treadmill 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          Trap bar deadlift 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Overhead press 4x5..7 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          Seated row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Farmer carry 3x45 seconds
        cooldown:
          full-body mobility 5 minutes

SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: 3x8..12. 
- Sets always come first: 3x10 means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: 3x8..12 rpe 7.
- Rest in seconds: rest 90 seconds.

Notes:
- No heavy spinal loading or loaded spinal flexion courses; substitute hip hinging and leg-dominant movements with neutral spine posture.
- If any movement causes discomfort, swap for a safe alternative (e.g., leg press for squats, horizontal pull instead of bent-over rows).
- Progression: aim to increase reps within the prescribed rep range first, then load incrementally when able to complete top end with comfortable RPE 7–8.
- Frequency: 3 days per week with at least one rest day between sessions; total duration per session around 45–70 minutes depending on phase.
- Conditioning can be added on off days if tolerated, via light cardio (20–30 minutes) and mobility work.
